name.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
name.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

caption.ja: 保存した浅角度の実電場を周期y方向へ再構成。灰色はPML領域です。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。
caption.en: Actual saved grazing electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction; gray shading marks the PML. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible.

formula: \partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf J=f\mathbf E-\omega_0^2\mathbf P-\gamma\mathbf J,\quad f=\Delta\varepsilon\omega_0^2

note.ja: 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。
note.en: A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

equation_note.ja: c=1、均質Lorentz媒質ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12はPML内まで連続。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時に細分化します。垂直粗格子はpeak6、弱減衰細格子対照はpeak12。長さ64、層幅12、中心32、幅4、carrier6は固定です。
equation_note.en: Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed.

name.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
name.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

latex: \psi^n=b\psi^{n-1}+c(D^n+D^{n-1}),\quad b=\frac{1-s_x\Delta t/2}{1+s_x\Delta t/2},\quad c=\frac{-s_x\Delta t/2}{1+s_x\Delta t/2}

note.ja: 80度の中心位相角を持つ有限波束をT=700まで進め、境界誤差を同格子の無PML参照から分離します。
note.en: Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid.

title.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照
title.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

references.formula: \widehat U^n(k_x)=M(k_x,\Delta t)^n\widehat U^0(k_x),\quad K_y=2\sin(k_y\Delta y/2)/\Delta y

assumptions.ja: 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。
assumptions.en: The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700.

note.ja: 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

reference_note.ja: 3つの格子・層強度の同時細分化、垂直・弱減衰対照の5長時間計算。参照入力が全て不変なことを確認して同一byteの無PML参照を再利用します。旧13検査本体を保持し、policy・peak12直接仕事の2回帰を追加。全44長時間判定は不変です。
reference_note.en: Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.

method_note.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
method_note.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.
